history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1836 in Baden and came to Chicago about 1865. He works as a wholesale grocer, and the household lives on the North Side near Clark Street and Chicago Avenue. The family's church is St. Michael's.
